name: pcp
description: Retrieve the user's long-term decisions, preferences, constraints, and cross-task context when they matter; selectively retain confirmed information.

interface.shortDescription: User context across conversations, projects, and tools.
interface.longDescription: Consult authorized long-term context when prior decisions, preferences, or constraints could change an answer or action. Read exact revision evidence, submit explicit feedback, and keep durable capture high-threshold through one approved local PCP client.
defaultPrompt: Search PCP for context relevant to this task.
Read the exact PCP revisions behind this result.
Retain this confirmed decision for later tasks.
